title: The full binary language is in polynomial time
statement: The language consisting of all finite binary strings belongs to the class of polynomial-time decidable languages.
replaced: Let $\mathsf{P}$ be the class of languages over $\{0,1\}$ decidable by a deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time. Then the language $\{0,1\}^*$ consisting of all bit strings belongs to $\mathsf{P}$.
